sv.title: Sanna Lundell: ”Relationen till min far är komplicerad, men också väldigt fylld av kärlek”

en.title: Sanna Lundell: "The relationship with my father is complicated, but also very full of love"

en.title: Philip Young invited men to rape his wife – four convicted
